worldcombat.skill.meanlook.summary: Pins one visible target in place with a dark, arresting gaze: the user must stand still and keep staring; if cover blocks the line, the target is dragged away, or the user is interrupted, the gaze breaks and the target is free at once. Hold the skill key to keep staring, release to stop.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.use.0: Pin a fleeing target in place for allies to finish
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.use.1: Lock a high-mobility target into the melee
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.use.2: Hold the enemy's main force in a one-on-one in the open
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.description.0: The gaze lasts up to about %1$s; dragged more than %2$s blocks from the user, or with the line of sight blocked, it snaps and the lock ends.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.description.1: It can begin gazing at a target within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.description.2: Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s. The user stands still and cannot act while gazing.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.option.on: Deep gaze: duration about x1.4 and snap distance +1 block, at wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +15 ticks and cast range -1 block - a longer, firmer lock that is slower and shorter ranged.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.option.off: Quick lock: a faster wind-up, longer range and shorter cooldown, at the cost of a shorter lock that is torn more easily.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, spends %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.growth.0: At level %1$s the gaze lasts %2$s and the cooldown falls to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.preference.de: On: duration about x1.4 and snap distance +1 block, at wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +15 ticks and cast range -1 block - a longer, firmer lock for holding a target that must not leave. Off (quick lock): a faster wind-up, longer range and shorter cooldown, at the cost of a shorter lock that is torn more easily - for breaking a move at a moment's notice.
worldcombat.skill.meanlook.preference.ai: The companion only considers a gaze on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it open from farther.
A gaze is only worth a cast when the target is within this distance - farther out the gaze cannot hold and the user just stands there.
On: a fleeing target scores one tier higher - one gaze pins it down; off: ranked as an ordinary control move. An already trapped target is never re-gazed.
When on, the companion may leave its post to gaze even under a hold order.
